no_outcome_selection: Launch scheduling uses documented package readiness, resource eligibility and engineering availability only; no TEST metric, prediction, tie pattern or pair outcome can choose cells or priorities.

Retain all four pre-registered rows in every interim/final report. State not-started, held, failed, interrupted, scoring-pending, invalid or result-reviewed explicitly, with evidence and timestamps; missing metrics are null, never zero, imputed or silently dropped.

Do not change remaining cells, frozen scorer/settings/population or claims after seeing an earlier cell. A common integrity defect may hold affected cells with a dated evidence-based correction and independent review; no tuning to TEST.

No cherry-picked best attempt, outcome-based rerun or early stopping; item-level resume preserves the exact admitted identity and commits. New attempts/changed identity require separate prospective review before execution; failed attempts remain visible.
change.async_rule: Within each cell, authenticated producer terminal/retained-container exit and durable resource release precede CPU preparation/start through the reviewed supervisor and authentic SERVICE publication. After release, the next independently admitted cell may use the chip while prior-cell CPU scoring/review continues. No sibling CPU or result barrier; no raw CPU argv invocation or automatic successor reservation.
change.retained_lifecycle: Keep fixed-name detached retained container, item-granularity resume, timestamp/count heartbeat, per-chip throughput with chip count and reserved memory, durable CephFS logs, exact relaunch command and terminal exit marker. Marker is completion truth; retained inspect/release independently establish ownership release. CPU has its own durable service/terminal evidence. Do not retry uncertain activation or run start/supervise concurrently.

evidence: Original accepted protocol and machine spec define each model on the same fixed 1088 requests with within-cell metrics, 134 fixed semantic pairs and descriptive controls.
DEV numerical admission is same-model reference/repeat/adapter, not cross-model equality. All four scoped reviews already exist.
The independent family review explicitly records other_cell_gate=false; each successor resource defect is local to its run/PLAN.
scientific_independence.finding_for_independent_review: No statistical cross-model completion prerequisite identified in these definitions. Shared resource ownership and common integrity are operational dependencies; neither grants a sibling lease nor permits changing the scientific workload.
scientific_independence.common_defect_rule: Evidence that a shared pin/scorer/population is invalid holds every actually affected cell, irrespective of scheduling independence. Preserve prior outputs and report status; review corrections prospectively.

rendering.choice: name if definition is null or empty, else name + ": " + definition; preserve exact source order and bytes of strings
rendering.score: source list strings verbatim, in ordinal list order; API index 0..K-1, display labels 1..K

noul.criteria: absent in all 226; refuse unseen criteria

rendering.question: verbatim instructions
rendering.gold_access: CPU gold_index only; render_question only accepts type/instructions/criteria
rendering.metadata: No facts, generator solutions, labels or _meta admitted to prompt

metrics.primary_hard: first argmax per source candidate order; map to semantic names before pair comparisons
metrics.native_tie: retain numpy argsort(-restricted_logprobs) result index, exact tie count and native-vs-first mismatch count; additionally score same metrics by native index when mismatches exist
metrics.nll: mean(-saved_restricted_logprobs[y]); never take log of rounded probability or clip
metrics.ece10: bins min(floor(10*max(p)),9); mean absolute bin accuracy-confidence weighted by bin count/N; hard first-max accuracy; confidence 1 in last bin
metrics.noul: P(true)=p[0]; decision true iff first argmax==0 (p_true>=0.5); NLL/Brier categorical plus mean((p_true-y_bool)**2)
metrics.choice: semantic_key=source ordered criteria keys[first_argmax]; no extra abstain or thresholds

score.decision: mode; expectation is descriptive only, no rounding into hard labels

metrics.thresholds: Identity/completeness/finite exact-vector gates only; no TEST-fitted risk/abstain/selective thresholds
metrics.invalid: fail cell on missing, extra, repeated, reordered, nonfinite, wrong-token or identity-mismatched prediction; preserve failure and no complete-population metrics

discrimination.limitations: same canonical schema, different input/gold, descriptive non-minimal pairs; no causal or invariance claim; no re-pairing

controls.uniform_hard_tie: first maximum in each original candidate order
controls.majority: canonical(type,instructions,criteria), mapping keys sorted only for schema hash; choose most frequent semantic gold, lexical semantic-key tie; emit one-hot mapped to original order
controls.oracle: TEST descriptive ceiling using labels; never inference/selection/calibration input; 805 schemas, high singleton leverage
controls.infinite_nll: exact one-hot wrong targets -> infinity with count; no smoothing

frozen.unconstrained_optimum: A finite source-record/label lookup reaches perfect accuracy and pair correctness. Same-schema constant/prior can exploit labels; constant distribution is perfect on a hypothetical invariance target. These are not semantic generalization.
